- Output: `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/1413.json`
- Trust decision: cell trust (`metadata.trusted`) may only come from data this app itself wrote to the system clipboard — `pasteFromSystemClipboard` keeps trust only when `matchesLastWrite` (recorded in `ClipboardImpl.setData`) matches, else inserts trust-stripped copies.
- `pattern_fit`: A (fix spans two packages: apputils clipboard primitive + notebook actions, with per-cell-type/metadata/output-type variants and a must-keep-working local copy→paste).
- Strongest lever: the provenance state must be produced in another package's primitive — a paste-site-only fix either untrusts legitimate local copy→paste (incl. cross-notebook) or breaks the `cellsPasted` copy/cut signal.
- Biggest red flag: none in the list; the main risks are unmeasurable repo size and unverified offline build/drag reachability (noted in `unverified`).
